book.deadrecall.vanilla_tweaks_manual.pa:
INVENTORIES

Hover the player or container side of an open menu and press the Sort Backpack key (middle mouse by default). The server validates the target.

WORLD

Lecterns use four slabs and one book. Bookshelves become Chiseled Bookshelves; wet Concrete Powder hardens, and hopper-smelted output releases recipe XP.

SKELETON QUIVERS

Skeletons first roll a base reserve from world difficulty: Easy 4–7, Normal 7–12, Hard 12–20. Vanilla local difficulty at the spawn position then adds ammo; mature regions can reach 7–10, 13–18, and 22–30. Arrows are collectible and empty archers switch to melee. See Enchanting for target changes.
message.deadrecall.sort_backpack.need_ba: Use the sort shortcut while a container screen is open
